audit.whatIsWrong: QA lint pass: dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d carried MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE findings.
audit.why: matchup-lint.js flagged these classes; QA pass owns them.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to enemy gender; duplicated dos/donts rephrased; kit cooldown digits added (Malzahar R 140s, Viktor W 17s, Neeko E 12s); Mimic magnitude claim replaced with its mechanic.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Poke E through the wave, catch the counter on your Q shield, land the empowered auto, and back off with the trade won.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Don’t cast E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — your long cast time is the opening every diver counts on.
